slice: DICTIONARYWDFLT and default PLACEHOLDER low-level DXF serializers
scope: Typed WDFLT and PLACEHOLDER record emission, plus one-import DXF/DWG origin and identity evidence; no root-graph routing or broad support claim.
implementation: Added dxfRW::writeDictionaryWithDefault with remapped self, owner, child, and default handles.
Emits AcDbDictionary, optional post-R14 code 281, ordered group-3/group-350 child pairs, AcDbDictionaryWithDefault, and group 340.
Rejects nonzero hardOwner because the Autodesk DICTIONARYWDFLT DXF grammar has no group-280 carrier.
Rejects nonzero cloning for AC1014 output because group 281 is unavailable there.
Authored child keys and target identities use bounded uniqueness admission; remapped zero child/default handles are refused.
Added dxfRW::writeAcDbPlaceholder for object/handle, optional persistent reactors, and required owner; XDATA and extension-dictionary state are refused.
DICTIONARYWDFLT cloning is constrained to Autodesk's documented 0-5 enum; AC1014 nonzero cloning is refused because group 281 is absent.
The concrete adapter retains DXF-origin WDFLT and PLACEHOLDER raw companions in dedicated lists and records typed/raw ranges in a separate per-import receipt.
The receipt validator binds WDFLT typed/raw identity and owner, checks the default pointer against exactly one placeholder owned by the WDFLT, and enforces the source-format raw-versus-typed route.

authoritative_reference.title: Autodesk DXF Reference: DICTIONARYWDFLT
authoritative_reference.use: Subclass order, group-3/group-350 entries, AcDbDictionaryWithDefault subclass, group-340 default hard pointer, and 0-5 cloning enum; the published grammar has no group 280.

placeholder_reference.title: Autodesk DXF Reference: ACDBPLACEHOLDER
placeholder_reference.use: Object name, handle, optional persistent reactors, and required owner; the published table has no subclass, XDATA, or extension-dictionary field.

generated_controls.source: In-memory DXF authored locally at test time; no committed DWG/DXF fixture.
assertions: Literal wire ordering, group roles, class subclass sequence, group-280 absence, allowed cloning values, and remapped identities.
The code-340 default handle equals the placeholder code-5 handle; placeholder code-330 owner equals the WDFLT code-5 handle.
Typed parseback preserves complete WDFLT payload, child handles, default handle, and representable cloning value; raw placeholder parseback preserves its identity and owner.
Concrete dx_iface file import retains both raw companion families and admits exact generation/owner/default identity; wrong owner and duplicate raw identity are rejected.
A synthetic DWG-origin receipt control validates typed-only WDFLT/PLACEHOLDER pairing; this is not a real DWG witness.
Nonzero hardOwner, AC1014 nonzero cloning, cloning outside 0-5, and ownerless placeholder controls preserve an existing destination and permit same-writer retry after correction.
